mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate pramipexole's orthostatic hypotension and dizziness, while pramipexole may worsen electrolyte abnormalities through dopaminergic effects on renal function.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (especially potassium), and renal function regularly; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions and ensure adequate hydration.
